name: Tateyama (Chiba, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tateyama city emblem in navy: an outlined ring of concentric lines divided by a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Tateyama, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 December 1939.

features.role: Tateyama city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines divided by a vertical bar
